quests.title: Quadratic Equation Champion
quests.description: Master quadratic equations and become the ultimate problem-solving champion!

story.introduction: The Quadratic Kingdom faces a crisis! Only a true champion can solve the ancient quadratic puzzles and restore balance.

steps.title: The Ultimate Formula Challenge
steps.narrative: The Quadratic Sage presents the most challenging equation. Use the quadratic formula to solve it!

problem.question: Solve using quadratic formula: 2x² - 7x + 3 = 0
problem.explanation: Using quadratic formula: x = (7 ± √(49-24))/4 = (7 ± 5)/4. So x = 3 or x = 1/2.
